Officials Prepare for El Nino Impact, Assess Drought Risks

Following directives from a minister, officials are assessing the potential impact of El Nino, including drought conditions. A contingency plan is being drafted to mitigate adverse effects, with daily situation assessments and coordination efforts underway. The focus is on preparing districts and appointing liaison officers to manage the situation.
